{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Black Bayou Gas Storage Header Pipelines''' is a proposed natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjects_May2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2025/04/24/2025-07066/black-bayou-gas-storage-llc-notice-of-availability-of-the-environmental-assessment-for-the-proposed|title=federalregister.gov|website=federalregister.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline is proposed to run from Black Bayou salt dome storage site, Cameron and Calcasieu Parishes, Louisiana to Interconnects with 10 interstate pipelines, Cameron and Calcasieu Parishes, Louisiana.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2025/04/24/2025-07066/black-bayou-gas-storage-llc-notice-of-availability-of-the-environmental-assessment-for-the-proposed|title=federalregister.gov|website=federalregister.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjects_May2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
